question: Which of the following is the main active ingredient of clove oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eugenol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Eugenol** is the main active ingredient of clove oil.
 
• Clove oil is derived from the flower buds of the clove tree, scientifically known as **Syzgium aromaticum**.
